create.name: Anamika Neitlich
create.bio:
Anamika Neitlich, known in her writing and teaching simply as Anamika, is an American teacher of consciousness and energy work living in California. After studying psychology at Wellesley College, she took a PhD in psychology at Columbia Pacific University, and she also graduated from the Barbara Brennan School of Healing. She says she has perceived energy since early childhood. Over five decades of private sessions, groups and workshops with people around the world, her work has come to combine psychology, metaphysics, spirituality and energy healing.

She describes her approach as invitational rather than instructional. Her sessions and gatherings centre on presence, deep listening and what she calls coherence transmissions: guided energetic journeys intended to help people experience more of who they are. She sees individuals and couples by Zoom or phone, leads small shared intensive groups and a community membership, and gives a monthly online workshop with a new theme each time; sessions are also offered in French. Among her books are and…, Loving Now, Love in Fur Coats, about her animal companions, and French Lessons in Love. She also teaches on The Shift Network.

books.title: and...
books.author: Anamika
books.description: A short experiential book built around the word "and" as an alternative to "but" or "or". It presents a way of feeling, being and creating that holds possibilities together rather than closing them down.

books.title: Loving Now
books.author: Anamika
books.description: A memoir of twelve years in Anamika's life, moving from seeking love to falling in love and then to a wider experience of loving in the present. It follows a series of life-changing events and what she learned from them.

books.title: Love in Fur Coats: Gifts from my Animal Companions
books.author: Anamika
books.description: True stories of the bond and communication between Anamika and the animals she has lived with. The book explores the intimacy and partnership possible between people and animals.

books.title: French Lessons in Love...and some lessons in language too
books.author: Anamika
books.description: A true story that begins as an online language exchange between an American woman and a French man and grows into an unusual relationship across two continents. It explores love, freedom and authentic relating.

courses.title: Private Sessions for Individuals and Couples
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by Zoom, FaceTime or phone for individuals, couples, families or close friends. Sessions combine presence, energy work and practical perspectives, and are also available in French.
courses.price: $200 USD for 30 minutes; $400 USD for 60 minutes

courses.title: Shared Intensive Groups
courses.description: Small Zoom groups of up to four people meeting for an hour, usually every other week for a month, with the option to continue. Each person receives fifteen minutes of focused attention within the shared group.

courses.title: We Have It All Backwards (monthly online workshop)
courses.description: A ninety-minute online workshop with a guided energetic journey, exploring what changes when we stop trying to become something and experience what is already here. It can be joined live or bought later as a recording.

courses.title: Community Membership
courses.description: An ongoing online community group with Anamika, open by application. Applicants first book a paid 30-minute session to see whether the group is a good fit; members also receive a discount on the monthly workshops.

flags: She publishes and brands herself simply as "Anamika" (Amazon author name and website); the listing uses Anamika Neitlich as on The Shift Network. A human may prefer the single name.

Five of the eight videos are unlisted uploads on her own channel (the channel shows no public videos) that she embeds on anamika.com/media-videos; all pass oEmbed, but they are short (2–11 minutes) and have very low views.
Her bio on anamika.com mentions trauma repair and nervous system regulation; I left these out of the Spiritpedia bio.
The monthly workshop changes every month; the November 2026 one will need replacing after 8 November.
Her Shift Network page lists a new live course starting November 2027 with no course page yet.
Private sessions included as an offering because one-to-one work is her main way of working.
left_out: The Beautiful Language of the Heart (book, ASIN B0DTJHCGXB, and companion documentary): the story of a young man with nonspeaking autism, so it names a condition.
Book-promo clips about The Beautiful Language of the Heart and short excerpts under 2 minutes on her channel.
The and... Trilogy: not yet published ('coming soon').
Individual Online Intensives ($175 USD / 30 min, $350 USD / 60 min): a discounted series of the same private sessions, shares a page with the Shared Intensive Groups.
Instagram @anamikascommunity not linked: 40 followers and no posts.
No free resources found apart from the video excerpts already listed.
